messages:
Elaine (CS): Quick check-in — VectorBlue dedicated pool go-live scheduled Tue 09:00 PT. We still need final quota confirmation and autoscale policy. Who can own final sign-off?

Mohit (Eng): I can own the quota numbers. Current proposal: baseline 80k tokens/min (steady), burst up to 120k for short tails. Autoscale min=2, target=4, max=10 nodes. That gives headroom for short surges while keeping cost predictable.

Jamal (Ops): Sounds reasonable. Ops requests a warmup and a smoke run on Mon 18:00 PT to prime caches and verify routing. Please avoid traffic > 75% of burst during that slot.

Sophia (ML): One ask from ML: please reserve fallback to the 8-bit quantized variant for the 2 smaller zones — model size difference reduces p99 by ~20%. We'll want to test quality regression with a small eval set during the load test.

Alex (Solutions): Noted. Also flagging renewal risk: VectorBlue has an internal SLA target of p95 < 200ms for embeddings routes. If we miss the p95 latency for 3 consecutive days after launch, they escalate renewal concerns. Let's add an automated alert and a playbook.

Mohit (Eng): Agree on alerts. I'll add the following autoscale policy snippet to the config: 

```
policy: cpu-and-queue
scale_up: when queue_length > 50 for 30s
scale_down: when cpu_avg < 30% for 120s
min_nodes: 2
max_nodes: 10
```

Elaine (CS): Can we run a loadtest plan that includes both gen and embedding traffic shapes? VectorBlue expects mixed traffic patterns.

Jamal (Ops): Yep. Ops will run k6 scenarios on Mon 18:00 PT. Proposed simple command: 

```
k6 run --vus 200 --duration 10m mixed-traffic.js
```

Mohit (Eng): Sharing the quick mixed-traffic script we'll use (very small snippet): 

```
// mixed-traffic.js (k6)
export default function () {
  http.post('/v1/generate', { prompt: 'short' })
  if (Math.random() < 0.3) {
    http.post('/v1/embeddings', { text: 'sentence' })
  }
}
```

Sophia (ML): For the quality eval: I'll run a 200-sample regression against the quantized fallback. Will post results before the Mon warmup.

DeployBot: pool pb-vec-004 created in us-west2, assigned to VectorBlue (dedicated).

Alex (Solutions): To reduce renewal risk, propose: 1) pre-warm cache on Mon, 2) 48h monitoring window post-launch with daily check-ins, 3) canary routing 10% for first 6 hours then 50% for next 18h, then full shift if stable.

Mohit (Eng): Canary routing is doable. We'll implement header-based routing + weight ramp. I'll coordinate with Jamal for traffic cutover windows.

Elaine (CS): Action items: 
- Mohit: finalize quota & autoscale config by EOD today.
- Sophia: upload quantized eval results by Mon 12:00 PT.
- Jamal: schedule k6 warmup Mon 18:00 PT and post results.
- Alex: draft the renewal-risk playbook and alert thresholds.

Please react with :thumbsup: when you accept the task or mention if different owners needed.

Mohit (Eng): :thumbsup: I got it — finishing numbers now.

Jamal (Ops): :thumbsup: Ops slot reserved.

Sophia (ML): :thumbsup: will upload by Mon noon.

Alex (Solutions): :thumbsup: drafting playbook now.

Elaine (CS): Thanks team. If any blocker pops up, post here and we'll escalate to oncall.

Jamal (Ops): small note — please keep any model retrain pushes off Wed-Fri next week; won't have spare ops windows.

Mohit (Eng): noted, will avoid deploys during that window.

Elaine (CS): Closing loop — will run a 30-min enablement call with VectorBlue on Tue 07:30 PT to walk through failover and dashboards. Invite sent. :calendar:
